name: LlamaIndex
shortDescription: Open-source framework for retrieval and agents over your own data. Cloud free tier unconfirmed.
longDescription: LlamaIndex is aimed at retrieval over your own data, with agent utilities on top of the core library. We installed and imported llama-index-core. The pricing page loaded, but the crawl did not clearly show a free cloud tier, so that part stays unconfirmed.
pricingNotes: Confirm LlamaCloud tiers on official pricing page before publishing $ amounts.
freeTierNotes: OSS core is free to install. Pricing page HTTP 200 but crawl text did not clearly extract a free SaaS tier; treat cloud free tier as unconfirmed from this pass.
bestFor: RAG pipelines over documents you already have
Python teams building retrieval into an agent
notIdealFor: Anyone who needs a confirmed free cloud tier from this check
smokeTestNotes: Install/import only; no API key, no LLM invoke, no signup.
